en.headline: Lan Kwai Fong Monster Mash returns for three Halloween Saturdays
en.dek: The district’s cosplay and street party events run on 17, 24 and 31 October from 7pm to 11pm, with DJs, face painting and roaming performances.
body: Lan Kwai Fong is holding its Monster Mash Halloween events on three consecutive Saturdays through the end of the month.

According to the Lan Kwai Fong Association, the events take place on 17, 24 and 31 October from 7pm to 11pm. They include live DJs at The Plaza, a face-painting station, and roaming monster performances on the streets.

More than 20 venues in the district are offering food and drink promotions during the broader Halloween period from mid-October to 31 October. The association has said it expects foot traffic to be higher than last year.
The events are free to attend on the streets, with additional dining offers available at participating restaurants.

zh.headline: 蘭桂坊怪物巡禮夜重臨 三個星期六舉行
zh.dek: 活動於10月17、24及31日晚上7時至11時舉行，設有DJ、化妝及街頭表演。
body: 蘭桂坊本月舉行怪物巡禮夜萬聖節活動，連續三個星期六進行。
根據蘭桂坊協會，活動分別於10月17、24及31日晚上7時至11時舉行，包括The Plaza現場DJ、化妝櫃位，以及街頭怪物表演。
由十月中至月底，區內逾20間食肆提供飲食優惠。協會表示預期人流較去年有所增加。
街頭活動免費參與，參與餐廳另有餐飲優惠。
